_about: Test fixture, not GenClass's plans: billing/plans.json as it was on 2026-10-21 (Free; Individual at US$29 a month on Stripe Checkout, a classifier a person from GenClass trains; Enterprise by email and by GenClass's own grant). The tests of selling one paid plan (test/one-paid.test.ts: Checkout, the billing page's Upgrade button, a purchase a person follows up) and of scripts/stripe-setup.mjs (through GENCLASS_PLANS_FILE) load it in place of billing/plans.json, so they keep exercising code the real plans no longer reach. The real plans are checked in test/plans.test.ts.
footer: Questions about Enterprise, self-hosting or invoices? Email mehar@daybot.ca.

plans.name: Free
plans.summary: The open-source runtime, its on-device model and the dashboard, for every app.

features.text: The open-source runtime (Apache-2.0) with every mode: observe, guard and heal
The on-device model
The dashboard for every app: what GenClass found, on which pages, and what it did
Unlimited apps
90 days of dashboard history
Full data export: every event GenClass received for your apps, as JSONL or CSV, by download or API
Forward detections to Sentry, PostHog, Datadog, Slack or a signed webhook
Interaction analytics: clicks, scrolls and time on page (coming next)
The genclass.dev page check
Private mode: run the open-source collector on your own Cloudflare account, so your data never passes through us

plans.name: Individual
plans.summary: Everything in Free, plus your own classifier, trained by GenClass.

features.text: Everything in Free
Your own classifier: we train a GenClass model on your app's traffic, bug reports or labelled examples and ship it as a private model your runtime loads
A person from GenClass emails you within 1 business day of purchase to start
1 year of dashboard history
Email support from mehar@daybot.ca

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.summary: GenClass's models run in our cloud for your apps, on terms we agree with you.

features.text: Everything in Individual
GenClass's models run in our cloud for your apps, for pages and devices that cannot run them on-device
A classifier for each of your products
Self-hosting, invoices and a contract, by agreement
Priority support
